description: This file defines a React functional component 'Dashboard' for a web-based dashboard interface, including tab management, viewport control, and interaction with a backend via WebSocket channels.

methods.name: tabFavicon
methods.description: Generates a favicon character based on the hostname of a URL.

methods.name: Dashboard
methods.description: Main React functional component implementing the dashboard UI with tab management, viewport, and interaction controls.

methods.name: imgCoords
methods.description: Calculates image coordinates from mouse event relative to the displayed frame.

methods.name: sendMouseEvent
methods.description: Sends mouse events ('mousedown' or 'mouseup') to the channel with calculated coordinates.

methods.name: onScreenMouseDown
methods.description: Handles mouse down events on the screen, toggling interaction mode or sending events.

methods.name: onScreenMouseUp
methods.description: Handles mouse up events on the screen, sending the event if in interactive mode.

methods.name: onScreenMouseMove
methods.description: Handles mouse move events, throttled, sending coordinates to the channel.

methods.name: onScreenKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events, including escape to cancel locator picking.

methods.name: onOmniboxKeyDown
methods.description: Handles Enter key in URL/search box to navigate.
